known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.98.1 ### Installation method Microsoft Store ### Area(s) with issue? Always on Top ### Steps to reproduce I placed a window to be always-on-top with a custom shortcut. The windows does stay on top. I then activate a key re-map in Keyboard Manager and the previous window is no longer on-top. I have to re-activate the always-on-top shortcut twice to get the window on-top again. ### ✔️ Expected Behavior Activation of a key re-map doesn't affect always-on-top function. ### ❌ Actual Behavior It affects. ### Upload Bug Report ZIP-file _No response_ ### Additional Information Windows 11 EN 25H2 ### Other Software _No response_
